programme.title: Munna Michael
programme.desc: Michael, an aging dancer, finds purpose raising an abandoned baby, Munna, who dreams of dancing. Together, they navigate challenges, gangsters, and the quest for love.

programme.title: MS Dhoni - The Untold Story
programme.desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

programme.title: Bhoothnath Returns
programme.desc: Bhoothnath returns from the afterlife to contest elections, fighting corruption and inspiring change. Mixing comedy, fantasy, and social satire, it delivers a heartfelt message of honesty and hope.

programme.title: Singham Returns
programme.desc: Owing to the wrongdoings similar to black money, an honest police officer returns as the Deputy Commissioner of Police to wipe out injustice.

programme.title: Ladies Vs Ricky Bahl
programme.desc: A smooth-talking con man lives by deceiving women until fate turns on him. His own schemes backfire, teaching him that tricks come back to trap the trickster. In the end, justice prevails.

programme.title: A Thursday
programme.desc: One fateful Thursday in the city of Mumbai invites tremendous horror when Naina, a nursery school teacher, holds 16 children hostage and produces a list of unfathomable demands.

programme.title: Arjun Reddy
programme.desc: Arjun Reddy, a successful young medical surgeon, sets out on the path of self-destruction when his lady-love is forced to marry another man.

programme.title: Chori Chori
programme.desc: Two strangers pretending to be lovers to save money end up falling for each other. Their lighthearted journey explores love, trust, and serendipity in this charming romantic comedy.

programme.title: Ok Jaanu
programme.desc: Adi and Tara move to Mumbai and fall in love. They agree to a casual relationship, but their careers cause problems. Will they choose love or their ambitions.

programme.title: Taarzan: The Wonder Car
programme.desc: Deven Ajay tries to sell the design of an advanced car to Rakesh, who steal his design and kill him. 12 years later his son Vatsal rebuilds the car, which avenges his death.

programme.title: Dhoom 2
programme.desc: Mr. A, a daring thief, steals priceless artifacts and partners with a woman he likes but distrusts. Meanwhile, three relentless police officers chase them, leading to a high-stakes pursuit.

programme.title: Jolly LLB 2
programme.desc: A blunt, compassionate lawyer moves from Kanpur to Lucknow to chase a big-time dream, facing struggles, tough choices, and personal growth along the way.

programme.title: Gunday
programme.desc: Two orphaned boys grow into powerful outlaws in 1970s Calcutta. As love and betrayal enter their lives, their bond is tested in this story of friendship, ambition, and rebellion.

programme.title: Stree
programme.desc: A town is held in the grip of terror by tales of a mysterious woman who calls men by their name and then abducts them, leaving their clothes behind.

programme.title: Deewana
programme.desc: A woman torn between her lost husband and new love faces emotional turmoil. A story of romance, loss, and destiny, it explores how love endures beyond heartbreak and time.

programme.title: Venky Mama
programme.desc: Karthik becomes an orphan. Despite opposition from his superstitious grandfather, Venkatrathnam, his maternal uncle, decides to raise him as his own.

programme.title: Cash
programme.desc: Two groups of thieves put their best foot forward to pull off the successful heist of a precious diamond. However, they soon get caught in an intricate web of murder and deceit.

programme.title: Hum Hai Rahi Pyar Ke

programme.title: Selfiee
programme.desc: Vijay's license request triggers a heated clash with an obsessive RTO officer, Om, igniting a power struggle and revealing hidden tensions between celebrity and bureaucracy.

programme.title: Ram Setu
programme.desc: An atheist archaeologist turned believer must race against time to prove the true existence of the legendary Ram Setu before evil forces destroy the pillar of India's heritage.

programme.title: Baaghi 2
programme.desc: An army officer squares off against drug lords and Russian henchmen to save his ex-lover's kidnapped daughter in the underbelly of Goa, India.

programme.title: Bloody Ishq

programme.title: Pati Patni Aur Woh

programme.title: Fanaa

Switzerland had a game to forget at the corresponding stage of the 2022 World Cup when they were thrashed 6-1 by Portugal. However, they will be hopeful of a much stronger showing this time around, having topped a group containing Canada, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Qatar, before easing past Algeria 2-0 in the round of 32. Colombia have only scored five goals in their four matches, but that was enough for them to top their group and also beat Ghana 1-0 in the last round.

programme.title: Escobar by Escobar

programme.title: McLaren

programme.title: My Icon: Kadeen Corbin

programme.title: Villeneuve Pironi: Racing's Untold Tragedy
programme.desc: The relationship between F1 drivers Gilles Villeneuve and Didier Pironi, team-mates whose friendship was torn apart after a controversial ending to the 1982 San Marino Grand Prix.

programme.title: Dart Kings
programme.desc: A look at the game during the 1970s, '80s and '90s, shining a spotlight on unlikely sporting heroes including Eric Bristow, Jocky Wilson and Phil Taylor.

programme.title: Gascoigne
programme.desc: Documentary about Paul Gascoigne, which charts his rise to fame from his humble roots in the North East to the world stage and his subsequent personal problems. The film features an extensive interview with the troubled former footballing superstar, as well as comment from those who admired his skills, including Wayne Rooney, Jose Mourinho and Gazza's ex-England and Tottenham Hotspur team-mate Gary Lineker.

programme.title: My Icon: Casey Stoney
programme.desc: The football coach talks about her idols.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. Following a prolonged period of ill health, Turner intends to retire from the spotlight with her second husband, Erwin Bach. She bids farewell to her fans in the emotional documentary Tina. Directed by Dan Lindsay and TJ Martin, the film invites the singer to reminisce about her turbulent life and career with glowing contributions from friends, family and fans including Oprah Winfrey and Angela Bassett.

programme.title: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger?
programme.desc: Investigating the unsolved 2015 murder of John Palmer, who was nicknamed Goldfinger after his involvement in melting down gold from the 1983 Brink's-Mat robbery. Palmer was found dead in his Essex garden and while police originally believed he died of natural causes, they eventually confirmed the case was being treated as a professional hit.

programme.title: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger?
programme.desc: The search for John Palmer's killer leads to Tenerife, where he built a timeshare empire. Undercover stings and Russian mob ties expose the scale of his power.

programme.title: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger?
programme.desc: A professional hitman is suspected in John Palmer's murder, with evidence pointing to a cartel and an Eastern European enforcer.

programme.title: Costa Concordia: Chronicle of a Disaster
programme.desc: Documentary told from different perspectives of the sinking of the cruise ship, examining why it ran aground and how the chaotic evacuation took place.

programme.title: The Great Horsemeat Scandal
programme.desc: A look at the major news story that broke in 2013, when it was found that meat unfit for human consumption had been smuggled into the human food chain and turned into cheap frozen meals for companies including Aldi, Tesco, Lidl and Burger King. With testimonies from whistleblowers, detectives and activists.

programme.title: Murder at the Post Office
programme.desc: In 2010, the North Yorkshire village of Melsonby was left in shock when postmistress Diana Garbutt was found murdered in the post office she ran with her husband Robin. He claimed she'd been the victim of a violent intruder, but as detectives probed further, suspicion began to fall on him and he was convicted of her murder and sentenced to life in prison in 2011. This documentary re-examines the case, featuring interviews with those convinced Robin was wrongfully convicted and others who are unsure and still suspect he is guilty.

programme.title: Murder at the Post Office
programme.desc: At trial, the prosecution alleges Robin was stealing from the Post Office and evidence from the Horizon computer system is a key part of the case against him.

programme.title: Murder at the Post Office
programme.desc: Robin is sentenced to 20 years, but key evidence is missing, with none of his DNA on the murder weapon and data from the Horizon system unable be trusted.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Ghar Mein Ram Gali Mein Shyam
programme.desc: Amar weds a village belle and they move to the city where she meets her neighbours Mr and Mrs Dharamchand. Soon, Amar begins to doubt her fidelity and Dharamchand devises a scheme to separate them.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: China Gate

programme.title: Fifty Fifty

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon

programme.desc: Lori struggles to make a good impression in 'Day of the Dad', then in 'Small Blunder', desperate to have the best show-and-tell in class, Lily takes Lisa's shrink ray to school.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The school falls in love with Liam's life in 'Hunn-cutt Gems', then in 'Can't Lynn 'Em All', when Lynn is scouted for her athletic prowess, she soon becomes a professional Wrestler.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lance opens a gym in 'Bulking and Sulking', then in 'Wild Goss Chase', Lola starts a gossip column for the school paper.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln has to beat each of his sisters to get to the couch first to watch TV in 'Left in the Dark', and then in 'Get the Message', Lincoln rushes to erase a voicemail before Lori hears it.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln has his hands full when his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day, in 'Cover Girls', and then in 'Save The Date', Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Ronnie Anne.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The kids take home security to the next level in 'Lock 'N Loud', then in 'The Whole Picture', Lincoln and Clyde try to recreate all of Lincoln's childhood photos, before his memory fades.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Knowing Leni's history of spoiling surprises, the kids don't tell her about Mom's upcoming party. (S2, ep 21b).

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The Loudly Bones: Lisa discovers that the dinosaur bones she found in her backyard may not be what they seem. (S5, ep 24b).

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Hoping to win a song-writing contest, Luna wonders whether she should go with a song that's true to her sound, or try to make something that the whole world will love.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lynn finds an unexpected TV sports watching buddy in 'Good Sports', then in 'Geri-Antics', Lisa realizes that Pop Pop won't be around forever, and turns to science to ensure his longevity.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: With the help of Lincoln and Clyde, Lori banishes a ghost she believes is haunting her. But, when Fairway's golf team starts to struggle, Lori has to bring it, and its luck, back.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lola pretends to be a McBride to impress her sophisticated friend in 'Fam Scam', then in 'Farm to Unstable', realizing farm work is harder than they thought, the gang look for shortcuts.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The McBrides scramble to throw a birthday party for Nana Gayle in 'Cat-astrophe', then in 'Prize Fighter', Lola worries she's already washed-up when she wins a lifetime achievement award.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luna and the Moon Goats try to become a kids' band in 'Child's Play', then in 'Force of Habits', Lori and Luna start to notice their partners' habits.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: For a seemingly small price, Rusty gets Morpheus to cast spells for him in 'Let's Break A Deal', then in 'A Dish Come True', Lincoln starts to work at Dad's restaurant.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lori and Bobby find a kitten in 'Meet the Purrents', then in 'Apartment Complex', after telling her family how great her apartment is, Lori's sisters secretly take over her space.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln has to get to school on time but getting his sisters out proves an obstacle in 'Project Loud House', then in 'In Tents Debate', Lincoln has the deciding pick for the family holiday.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln worries that he's lost his manliness, so he and Clyde go camping in 'Roughin' It', then in 'The Waiting Game', Lincoln gets Lori a job at a pizza arcade, but gets her in hot water.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln and Clyde are foiled by a surprising nemesis in 'Pulp Friction', then in 'Pets Peeved' Lana brings home a new pet, so the original Loud pets scheme to get rid of him.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Carol Pingrey's photo gets more likes than Lori's in 'Selfie Improvement', and in 'No Place Like Homeschool', Lola is being temporarily homeschooled, and the other kids try to get in on it.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Dad worries Lola thinks he plays favourites in 'Home of the Fave', and in 'Hero Today, Gone Tomorrow', Lynn must be supportive when Lynn's friend is celebrated for a one-in-a-million goal.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lynn seeks a boyfriend just to fit in, in 'Singled Out', then in 'Brave the Last Dance', Clyde recruits Lincoln and the gang to find out if a girl he has a crush on feels the same way.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln has to get to school on time but getting his sisters out the door proves an obstacle. (S1, ep 5a).

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln starts spending time at Clyde's house after Clyde's dads give Lincoln more attention than he gets at home. (S1, ep 16a).

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lola is being temporarily homeschooled. Thinking it looks like fun, the other kids try to get in on it. (S3, ep 4b).

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs. (S3, ep 18a).

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lisa takes over her first-grade classroom in 'School of Shock', then in 'Electshunned', Leni goes toe-to-toe with the Mayor in a city-wide Royal Woods election.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln is on the hunt for his stolen birthday present in 'Present Danger', then in 'Stressed for the Part', after landing a role in a Dairyland production, Luan must hide the news.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luna faces a big rock competition in 'Hiccups and Downs', then in 'The Loathe Boat', The Morticians Club plan Bertrand's escape from the cruise ship his parents work on.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln tries to swap school classes after being separated from the gang, but ends up being transferred to Canada. Lori doesn't fit in on any of the college dorm floors. (S5, ep 1.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The school mascot is framed for a crime they did not commit in 'The Kanga-ruse', then in 'The Walking Bed', Lincoln finds ways to break a family rule about hand-me-downs.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Leni tries to thwart Lori's college plans in 'Don't You Fore-get About Me', then in 'Tough Cookies', Lincoln and Clyde start a cookie-making business, but it's harder than they realized.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln borrows Lynn's bike without telling her in 'Hand-Me-Downer', and then in 'Sleuth or Consequences', someone clogged the Loud House toilet and Lincoln sets out to find out whodunit.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln gets a tutor that all his sisters get crushes on, making it impossible for Lincoln to study in 'Study Muffin', then in 'Homespun', a tornado threatens to destroy the house.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Clyde tries to cure Lincoln's breakup blues in 'Back Out There', and in 'Spell it Out', Lucy is tired of her siblings walking all over her, so turns to a spell book to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln and Clyde worry that they may be too old to still be playing Ace Savvy in 'Deal Me Out', then in 'Friendzy', Lincoln discovers that having a friend over means special privileges.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The Louds rent a boat for a day trip on the lake in 'Washed Up', then in 'Recipe for Disaster', Lincoln and Clyde investigate when they discover a frozen food company using Dad's recipes.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lola teams up with Lily in 'A Star is Scorned', then in 'Senior Moment', Lori regrets everything she hasn't done in high school, and vows to make up for lost time in her senior year.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luan struggles to direct her school play in 'Director's Rut', then in 'Friday Night Fights', Lisa joins Lynn's football team as the analytics coach to prove that maths always beats heart.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln seeks a better seat in class in 'Musical Chairs', then in 'The Taunting Hour', Lynn gets heckled at her soccer game, and the Louds realize they all have critics.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln and Clyde overwater Howard's rare orchid in 'The Orchid Grief', and in 'Forks and Knives Out', Lynn Sr. is stoked to compete on a cooking show until he learns he's up against Rosa.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luna and the Moon Goats have to find a replacement guitarist in 'Music To My Fears', then in 'Fluff and Foiled', Lincoln is determined to get laundry duty finished as fast as possible.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The Louds gather ingredients for an italian chef in 'Nonna Your Business', and the road trip continues in 'Alpining Away', when Lynn crushes on a boy.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln avoids his chores in a high-tech way in 'Hologram Jam', then in 'Sick as a Dad', the Loud siblings are tasked with taking care of Dad when he overreacts to getting a cold.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln is going to his first rock concert in 'For Bros About to Rock', then in 'It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud House', Lincoln finds a letter suggesting there is money hidden in the house.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Mom and Dad win a trip to a resort and decide to take the kids in 'Suite and Sour', then in 'Back in Black', when Lucy gets a crush on a regular normal boy, her sisters give her a makeover.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Dad and Lincoln get on Legends of the Hidden Temple in 'Legends', and in 'Mall of Duty', Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he takes them to the mall.

programme.desc: Lana learns her favourite fish are in jeopardy in 'Scales of Justice', then in 'Crimes of Fashion', Leni gets fired from her job, so Lincoln and Clyde (as Ace and Jack) take on the case.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln worries that his friend group is splintering in 'Friends in Dry Places', then in 'Coupe Dreams', in order to buy her dream car, Lori becomes a local rideshare driver.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luna is worried about her friends seeing her perform in 'Dad Reputation', then in 'Dream a Lily Dream', Lisa discovers the only way to stop Lily's nightmares is to go inside her dreams.

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: The sisters think Lincoln is bad luck in 'No Such Luck', and in 'Frog Wild', when Lincoln finds out his class is dissecting frogs, he and Lana embark on a mission to rescue them.

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.title: What The Heck Kept This Off No.1?
programme.desc: Every one of these superb No.2 hits from 1970-1979 is a classic, but what other songs stopped each of them getting to the top? Queen, Ringo, Elton, Boney M and more are all here.

programme.title: Summer Loving!
programme.desc: Non-stop summer love songs, back to back, from the era of Leo Sayer, Carpenters, The Bee Gees & Minnie Riperton.

programme.title: MegaStar MiniHits! 1970-1979
programme.desc: Fifty hit songs from famous acts of the 70s - but not a single one made the top 10! Including Bowie, Mud, Abba, Whitesnake, Prince and Bay City Rollers.

programme.title: Groovy Little Numbers!
programme.desc: Over-bearded men and leftfield ladies - all with fabulous tunes! These are alternative hits from the West Coast, the underground and the counter culture of the 1970s.

programme.title: Tony Blackburn's SingerSongwriters
programme.desc: From Joni Mitchell to Judie Tzuke, Al Green to Elton John - the 70s was a classic decade for singer-songwriters who have stood the test of time. Tony Blackburn chooses the tunes.

programme.title: David Bowie: Sound & Vision!
programme.desc: From 1969's chart debut 'Space Oddity' to 1980's 'Ashes to Ashes' - Bowie was the ultimate icon of the decade. Here are 13 videos - with huge hits, but some you might not know.

programme.title: Essentials! 70s Folk Rock
programme.desc: 2 hours of superbly crafted songs inspired by different regions of the world. Including Simon & Garfunkel, Cat Stevens, James Taylor, Janice Joplin, Bob Dylan & Neil Young.

programme.title: Clare Grogan's Teenage Kicks!
programme.desc: The 5 years from '77 to '81 was possibly the most exciting & vibrant time to be a teenager & Clare Grogan was there - buying the records, seeing the bands & wearing the t-shirts.

programme.title: 70s Heatwave Hits!
programme.desc: Feelgood sunshine hits from the decade that gave us the summer of '76! T-shirts & bikinis at the ready.

programme.title: The NOW Yearbook 1973
programme.desc: 1973 was another top year in music, as Glam Rock ruled, Paul McCartney did Bond & the UK had its biggest Christmas chart battle ever! Simon Bates has the story - month by month.

programme.title: Sacramento
programme.desc: An energetic and free-spirited young man convinces his long-time friend, who's settled into domestic life, to go on an impromptu road trip from Los Angeles to Sacramento. Comedy, written, directed by and starring Michael Angarano, with Michael Cera and Kristen Stewart.

programme.title: Eddie the Eagle
programme.desc: Biopic of British sporting underdog Eddie Edwards. Determined to fulfil his dreams of becoming an Olympic athlete, Edwards trains as a ski jumper - a field in which Britain had no other competitors. He secures a place in the 1988 Winter Olympics, where his can-do attitude makes him a media sensation in the face of a losing streak. Starring Taron Egerton, Hugh Jackman and Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A writer struggling to complete the script for a movie about psychopathic killers turns to his criminal friends for advice. He ends up getting more than he bargained for when the small-time crooks kidnap a dog that belongs to a gangster, putting all their lives in danger. Comedy thriller, starring Colin Farrell, Sam Rockwell, Christopher Walken and Woody Harrelson.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: A bad-boy figure skater and his effeminate arch-enemy are banned from the sport after their intense rivalry results in a brawl. However, the pair find a loophole in the regulations allowing them to enter the world championships as the first ever same-sex pair - if they can put aside their differences long enough to compete. Comedy, starring Will Ferrell, Jon Heder, Will Arnett and Amy Poehler.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: After being taunted by relatives who think they will never have kids, married couple Pete and Ellie Wagner consider the option of adopting a child. However, they get more than they bargained for when they take in a rebellious teen and her two siblings. Director Sean Anders' comedy, starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Merced.

programme.title: Napoleon Dynamite
programme.desc: A socially inept high-school student and his lonely unemployed brother find their eccentric home life thrown into upheaval when their meddling uncle comes to stay. The teenage oddball tries to make the best of his changing circumstances, while putting all his skills to the task of helping his new best friend win the class presidency. Comedy, starring Jon Heder, Efren Ramirez and Haylie Duff.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: A married couple decide to put some passion back into their dull marriage by filming themselves having sex. However, a technological mix-up results in the footage being uploaded to various gadgets, and they race against time to recover all the copies before it ends up in the public eye. Comedy, starring Cameron Diaz and Jason Segel.

programme.title: Adult Life Skills
programme.desc: A woman returns to her home town to live in a shed belonging to her mother, who grows frustrated as her daughter regresses to childhood. A friendship develops between the directionless woman and a troubled young boy, which gives her the push she needs to develop a more independent outlook on life. Comedy, starring Jodie Whittaker and Lorraine Ashbourne.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: A recently divorced bookshop owner finds love with a glamorous Hollywood film star, but ends up the focus of unwanted media interest - which makes maintaining a relationship a tricky proposition. Romantic comedy written by Richard Curtis, starring Hugh Grant, Julia Roberts, Rhys Ifans, Emma Chambers, James Dreyfus and Gina McKee.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: An American police college lowers its entrance requirements in the hope of attracting new recruits, and in response, assorted dubious candidates turn up for enrolment. A short-tempered instructor is determined to weed out the bad apples, but a riot provides the clueless cops with a chance to prove their worth. Comedy, starring Steve Guttenberg, Kim Cattrall, Bubba Smith and GW Bailey.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: The arrival of secretive neighbours sparks an unhealthy curiosity in a group of friends, leading them to go to bizarre lengths to discover the truth about the newcomers. However, their investigations take an even weirder twist when they begin to suspect their unseen fellow suburbanites are part of a cannibalistic cult. Joe Dante's black comedy, starring Tom Hanks, Bruce Dern, Carrie Fisher, Corey Feldman and Henry Gibson.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: A former member of a singing trio, now running a hotel on a Greek island, is reunited with her old bandmates for her daughter's wedding - but is surprised when three of her old flames also show up unexpectedly. The three men have been invited by the bride, who wants to find out which one of them is her father. Musical comedy, with a soundtrack of Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgard and Amanda Seyfried.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: A bad-boy figure skater and his effeminate arch-enemy are banned from the sport after their intense rivalry results in a brawl. However, the pair find a loophole in the regulations allowing them to enter the world championships as the first ever same-sex pair - if they can put aside their differences long enough to compete. Comedy, starring Will Ferrell, Jon Heder, Will Arnett and Amy Poehler.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: A recently divorced bookshop owner finds love with a glamorous Hollywood film star, but ends up the focus of unwanted media interest - which makes maintaining a relationship a tricky proposition. Romantic comedy written by Richard Curtis, starring Hugh Grant, Julia Roberts, Rhys Ifans, Emma Chambers, James Dreyfus and Gina McKee.

programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
programme.desc: Cute furball Gizmo is reunited with his human friends Billy and Kate, who now work in the New York offices of an eccentric tycoon. However, it is not long before Gizmo has spawned a new generation of murderous carnivores, who quickly overrun the building - and a genetics lab where they produce even more startling mutations. Joe Dante's comedy sequel, starring Zach Galligan, Phoebe Cates, John Glover and Christopher Lee.

programme.title: Sausage Party
programme.desc: Frank the sausage and the other groceries are promised of the great beyond. When he hears life after the supermarket isn't as much fun as he thought, Frank the sausage investigates. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Seth Rogen, Kristen Wiig, Jonah Hill and Michael Cera.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's The Tuxedo
programme.desc: A bumbling chauffeur steps in to take the place of a secret agent injured in an explosion. Wearing the agent's hi-tech suit, and with the help of a rookie spy, the humble driver now has all the power he needs to stop a villain from gaining global domination by polluting the world's water supply. Comedy adventure, starring Jackie Chan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Jason Isaacs and Richie Coster.

programme.title: Finding Your Feet
programme.desc: A wealthy woman's privileged existence is shattered when she discovers her husband is having an affair with her best friend. Seeking solace, she turns to her estranged sister, who lives in a London council estate, and finds a new lease of life in joining her community dance class. Comedy, starring Imelda Staunton, Celia Imrie, Timothy Spall and Joanna Lumley.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: A former member of a singing trio, now running a hotel on a Greek island, is reunited with her old bandmates for her daughter's wedding - but is surprised when three of her old flames also show up unexpectedly. The three men have been invited by the bride, who wants to find out which one of them is her father. Musical comedy, with a soundtrack of Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgard and Amanda Seyfried.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: It's five years since Sophie invited her three possible dads to her wedding, and now most of her family are reunited as she prepares for the grand reopening of the Hotel Bella Donna. Along the way, she learns more about her mother's past. Abba-themed musical sequel, starring Amanda Seyfried, Lily James, Pierce Brosnan, Cher and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: An American police college lowers its entrance requirements in the hope of attracting new recruits, and in response, assorted dubious candidates turn up for enrolment. programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: America's most inept cops graduate and are let loose on the streets - under the command of an unscrupulous lieutenant whose promotion depends on their failure. Fortunately for him, their unique brand of policing actually leads to an increase in the crime rate. Comedy sequel, starring Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, David Graf and Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Boozy playboy Arthur Bach is content to drift through life without ambition and await the multimillion-dollar inheritance due to him following an arranged high-society wedding. programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: Fast-talking Detroit cop Axel Foley heads for Los Angeles after an old friend is murdered before his eyes. His search for the killers leads him into conflict with a seemingly untouchable drug kingpin, but he also has to contend with the local force, who do not want him taking matters into his own hands. Comedy thriller, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, Ronny Cox, John Ashton and Steven Berkoff.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
programme.desc: Wisecracking Detroit detective Axel Foley returns to Los Angeles to investigate the shooting of an old friend, and uncovers a connection with a spate of violent robberies carried out by a criminal who leaves a mysterious calling card. Comedy thriller sequel, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, John Ashton, Ronny Cox and Brigitte Nielsen.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Maverick cop Axel Foley returns to Los Angeles when an investigation into a colleague's murder leads him to a Hollywood theme park. He enlists the help of old ally Rosewood to prove the resort is a cover for a major counterfeiting ring connected to a terrorist conspiracy. Comedy adventure sequel, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, Theresa Randle and Bronson Pinchot.
